cases.name: upsert appends new keys in order
upsert replaces by key keeping the first-insertion slot
retract of an unknown key changes nothing
retract then upsert re-inserts at the end
commit keeps the entries in first-insertion order
commit of an emptied transaction is no edit
commit without yields is no edit
every yield after commit is refused
every yield after abort is refused

scenarios.name: press, drag and release commit one transaction
a second gesture is a second transaction
a click without a drag publishes nothing
dragging back to the origin commits no edit
magnet proximity upserts and retracts the connection
a drag starting on the magnet keeps the connection first
pointer events before a press are ignored
a host abort while dragging drops the transaction and rests the tool
a host abort without an open transaction reports idle
a gesture persisted and resumed between events is still one transaction
a host reset drops the transaction silently
a release that forgets to commit is refused and the next gesture opens a new transaction
an escape still aborts the leaky tool

invariants.statement: an upsert of a present key replaces its mutation in its first-insertion slot; a new key is appended
a retract removes its key; a retract of an absent key changes nothing; a later upsert of that key appends it
a transaction that commits with no entries publishes no edit
an aborted transaction keeps no entries and publishes nothing
a committed or aborted transaction refuses every yield with toolTransaction.closed and stays unchanged
one committed transaction is one edit, one undo step and one history row; every op carries its TransactionRef
a runner opens a transaction at the first upsert while none is open; retract, commit and abort without an open transaction change nothing
the transaction id is minted from the actor, the clock of the opening event and the tool
one event closes at most one transaction; a yield after the close within the same event is refused (toolTransaction.closed) and the event publishes nothing

an event that leaves the tool at rest (the root's initial state active) with its transaction open is refused (toolTransaction.unclosed); the transaction is dropped, so the next gesture opens a new one

persisting a runner (snapshot and open transaction) and resuming it between any two events yields the same steps and ids as the uninterrupted runner; resume refuses a closed transaction (toolTransaction.closed) and a resting snapshot holding an open transaction (toolTransaction.unclosed)

a host abort or reset drops the open transaction without an edit, cancels the timers and invokes of the configuration it leaves and returns the statechart to its initial configuration; abort reports aborted with its reason, or idle when nothing was open
the statechart configuration and context are ephemeral tool state; only committed mutations and their TransactionRef are durable
